stages.name: Inspect Project
stages.objective: Understand the existing project structure and requirements
stages.prompt: Inspect the repository at /workspace. List all files and read the test file to understand what functionality is expected. Report the project structure and what needs to be implemented.

stages.name: Implement Calculator
stages.objective: Implement the calculator module based on test expectations
stages.prompt: Implement the calculator.py module with add, subtract, multiply, and divide functions that pass all tests in tests/test_calculator.py. Write the complete implementation.

stages.name: Run Tests
stages.objective: Verify all tests pass with the implementation
stages.prompt: Run the test suite with: python -m pytest tests/ -q. Report the results including pass/fail counts and any failures.

metadata.description: Simple multi-stage implementation: inspect -> implement -> test
